## ARK Invest Buys $28M of Cerebras Stock After Post-Earnings Selloff

ARK's $28M opportunistic buy in a stated NVDA rival post-earnings selloff is a visible institutional signal on alternative inference compute; for PM, this is a directional read on whether the market is beginning to price competitive risk into NVDA's AI chip moat.

- ARK Invest purchased approximately $28M of Cerebras (CBRS) shares following an earnings-driven price decline.
- Headlines frame Cerebras explicitly as an 'Nvidia rival,' surfacing the AI chip competition narrative.
- ARK's counter-cyclical buy signals institutional conviction in CBRS despite near-term earnings disappointment.
- The move touches inference compute economics and AI chip design competition themes directly relevant to NVDA positioning.
